Name: Frostbite
Description: Reworks Freeze into Frostbite (Legends Arceus): Pokemon can act freely, takes 1/16 Max HP tick damage end of turn, and deals 50% Special damage. KNOWN GAP (found 2026-09-12, not yet fixed): this package does not touch Battle.cro 0x215CC-0x21628, a native block that checks 'move type == Fire' (CMP R0,#0x9 @0x215D8) then loops over party members testing status==3 (the same status id this package repurposes as Frostbite) and calls a helper at 0xE4870 on any match - almost certainly the vanilla 'hit by a Fire-type move thaws Freeze' rule. Since status 3 is shared/repurposed rather than given a distinct id, a Pokemon with the new Frostbite status is likely still incorrectly cured by any nearby Fire-type move, which doesn't match Frostbite's real (Legends Arceus) behavior. Needs 0xE4870 decoded to confirm it's really a cure-status call before a 5th SitePatch neutralizes it here - not yet attempted, flagging honestly rather than guessing a fix.
